go env GKWORK
stdout '^'$GKPATH'[\\/]src[\\/]go.work$'
go env
stdout '^(set )?GKWORK=''?'$GKPATH'[\\/]src[\\/]go.work''?$'

cd ..
go env GKWORK
! stdout .
go env
stdout 'GKWORK=("")?'

cd src
go env GKWORK
stdout 'go.work'

env GKWORK='off'
go env GKWORK
stdout 'off'

! go env -w GKWORK=off
stderr '^gecko: GKWORK cannot be modified$'

-- go.work --
go 1.18

use a
-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/a
